name: COP-37 (General Area) 50% Capital Subsidy Scheme for Project of Taluka & District Co-op. Purchase Sale Union
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Provides a 50% capital subsidy to cooperative unions, with a maximum limit of ₹20,00,000/-.  - **Improved Services for Farmers:** Enables unions to offer better and more diverse services to farmers, such as providing quality agricultural inputs, procuring produce at support prices, and offering modern processing and storage facilities.  - **Enhanced Infrastructure:** Su
_eligibility_text: 1. Taluka or District Cooperative Purchase and Sale Associations are eligible under this scheme. 1. Taluka and District Purchase and Sale Associations should have their own land.
